run_curate_nyu_dataset: run the script to curate NYU depth dataset from SUNRGBD scene directories into a JSONL file
curate_nyu_images_and_depth: curate NYU images and depth maps by sampling 100 valid pixels per image and computing euclidean distances
extract_camera_intrinsics: extract camera intrinsic matrix parameters from intrinsics.txt files in SUNRGBD scene directories
sample_valid_depth_pixels: sample 100 random valid depth pixels between 0.005 and 25 meters from a depth map
compute_3d_coordinates: compute 3D world coordinates and euclidean distances from pixel coordinates using camera intrinsics and depth values
